Both gate judge.toml files use 'aggregation = "all_pass"' with a single 'type = "binary"' criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:15-20, gates/constraints/judge.toml:15-20), so a gate is 0 or 1 and '> 0.0' is the pass test. Gates are substantive, not cheap: render requires wrong-password refusal plus real Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace; constraints requires UI-created job + candidate read back by the Observer in an independent browser context ('A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'). Scored prompts restate the same backend gate (functional prompt.md:11-13, polish prompt.md:11-12, visual prompt.md:11-12 zero/Likert-1 for a static shell). MEASURED (local execution of the frozen score.py + scoring.toml copied to the session scratchpad with synthetic RewardKit outputs; not a verifier/judge run): render=0 -> exit 1, reward 0.0000, gates_passed 0; constraints=0 with a full-marks scored file present -> exit 1, reward 0.0000, weighted 0.0 (scored ignored); gates pass but no scored output -> reward 0.0000, floors_passed 0; functional=0.0 polish=1 visual=1 -> weighted 0.4 but reward 0.0000 (floor blocks polish/visual farming); functional=0.05 (at floor) polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0000; functional=0.0599 polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.4359; full -> 1.0000; missing gate key -> exit 2 (test.sh then writes plain zero). NOTE (not a defect of this row): the 0.05 floor is the template-mandated value (staged-task-contract.md scoring.toml block) and is thin: functional total weight is 58.5 over 43 criteria, so >2.925 weight clears it. A gate-passing intake-only app with validation and persistence could plausibly earn hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 + hro_restart 1.5 = 3.5 (functional ~0.060) and then collect visual (max 0.2 reward) => e.g. functional 0.0598, visual 0.5 gives reward 0.1359 in the local run. That is a minimally working app, not a non-working one, so the row's 'stops a non-working app' clause holds; most refusal rows need positive controls (functional prompt.md:13 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control'), so a dead app cannot farm functional mass from refusals. Ranking/weight honesty belongs to rows 42/44; the floor value is template policy and must not be changed here.
